subject: Left Field OPM Contract Approval
overview: The MPS High School Building Committee reviewed their progress with the Massachusetts School Building Authority and voted to approve the contract for Left Field as the project's Owner's Project Manager.

items.title: MSBA OPM Panel Update
items.summary: Chair Jenny Graham updated the committee on a successful review session with the MSBA's OPM panel regarding the selection of Left Field, and outlined upcoming timeline expectations.

items.title: Left Field OPM Contract Approval
items.summary: The committee approved the contract for Left Field as the Owner's Project Manager after clarifying that independent cost estimating fees would be billed in addition to the flat fee.

items.title: Future Meeting Schedule and Designer Selection
items.summary: The committee discussed plans to establish a standing monthly meeting schedule and announced that next week's in-person meeting will focus on the designer selection phase.
